messages:
Maria: FYI we observed a p95 latency regression in eu1 after the quantization change pushed at 02:10 UTC. Short prompts jump from ~220ms to ~1.1s.
Jamal: any customer-facing errors or just tail latency?
Maria: latency only, no 5xx. Two tenants triggered SLA alerts. attaching trace: tokenizer CPU spikes for short sequences.
Liam: what's the minimal fix? can we do a config revert?
Maria: yes. revert to previous kernel selector for sequences <=64. Built image: registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-a1
Sasha: sounds safe. plan: dry-run -> 10% canary 10m -> evaluate -> ramp. prefer a manual hold before full roll to verify long-tail metrics.
Emily: Ops wants this expedited. customers on alert need relief within 30m if possible.
Maria: initiating dry-run now.
Deploybot: [dry-run] registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-a1 validated against staging, smoke checks passed.
Maria: deploy command I'll use:
```
/deploy start --cluster eu1 --image registry.redwood/inference/eu1:hotfix-quant-a1 --canary 10% --canary-window 10m --auto-rollback-metric "predict.latency.p95" --rollback-threshold 400
```
Liam: +1 from release if we add a manual hold before global ramp.
Sasha: +1 from SRE. I'll monitor traces and CPU. set notify to #incidents and pager.
Jamal: +1 from oncall. add rollback tag: rollback:quant-revert-2026-03-21 and notify me.
Maria: tag added: rollback:quant-revert-2026-03-21. notifying #incidents in 30s.
Emily: approving expedited canary. :thumbsup:
Deploybot: [deploy] canary start 10% in eu1
Deploybot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 (5m window) baseline=230ms current=265ms
Sasha: tracing shows tokenizer CPU back to baseline for canary traffic.
Jamal: tenant A's alerts cleared. will keep watch for 15m.
Deploybot: [canary] 10% -> success. holding for manual approval to proceed to 50%.
Liam: manual approval granted, proceed to 50% then hold.
Maria: ramping to 50%.
Deploybot: [deploy] scaling canary -> 50%
Deploybot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 now=280ms
Sasha: p95 stable, no uptick in errors. fine to go full when release approves.
Emily: proceed to 100% and ping support to standby.
Maria: rolling to 100%.
Deploybot: [deploy] rolling to 100% in eu1
Deploybot: [metric] predict.latency.p95 now=295ms
Jamal: post-deploy checks: customer alerts resolved, latency back under SLA. Nice work team.
Liam: will add note to release history: "hotfix: revert kernel selector for short sequences to address p95 regression; eu1 rolled 100% on 2026-03-21; rollback tag rollback:quant-revert-2026-03-21".
Maria: added release note and closing thread. Thanks everyone. :tada:
